title: Cordyceps mind-controlling bullet ants
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Cordyceps mind-controlling bullet ants, about present at Amazon, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Bullet ants in the Amazon eat cordyceps mushrooms, which co-opt their brains and movements and [inaudible] mind-control them onto higher ground where a fruiting body sprouts from the head of the ants.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes how bullet ants in the Amazon rainforest eat cordyceps, a kind of mushroom. According to him, the fungus takes over the ants' brains and movements and steers them to higher ground, where a mushroom stalk then sprouts from each ant's head. He tells it in a conversation that treats mushrooms as a kind of mind control, perhaps even alien in origin.
